account: In a June 2025 account, the Centre for Gender and Politics proposed an AI version of its GaP Repository. The AI version would use multilingual natural language processing, contextual recommendations and mentorship matching to help young women in South Asia find political information and guidance. The launched repository uses a conventional content-management system without these AI functions. On 29 October 2026 the GaP Repository web page still offered a filtered list of curated resources and none of the proposed AI functions. No outside source reports that an AI version was built or evaluated.

ai_role.statement: Proposed NLP, contextual recommendation, and mentorship-matching functions would personalize access and guidance.
